_about: Grounded Q&A gold set. role = who asks (student → public knowledge only). A question passes retrieval when any retrieved source_ref contains one of expected_sources; it passes the answer check when the answer contains any of must_include (and every item of must_include_all). Gold values are copied verbatim from the synthetic dataset files.
